entries.message: On Mac, Crest no longer quits while it prepares an import from Arc or another browser when some of that browser's data is damaged.
On Mac, when Crest can't prepare an import from another browser, the review now shows an error with Back and Skip instead of quitting.
Importing from Arc keeps the names you gave tabs there, and the import review shows them. Clearing a name shows the page's title again.
